SELECT DISTINCT SM.SALES_NO , SD.SALES_SEQ , SD.PRODUCT_CODE , IM.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME , IM.HS_CODE , SD.QUANTITY , IM.UNIT , SD.UNIT_PRICE , SD.AMOUNT FROM (
SELECT #{d.sales_no} AS SALES_NO, #{d.division_code} AS DIVISION_CODE, #{d.sales_seq}::numeric AS SALES_SEQ
SELECT NULL::text AS SALES_NO, NULL::text AS DIVISION_CODE, NULL::numeric AS SALES_SEQ WHERE 1=0
) KEYS INNER JOIN SALES_MST SM ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND SM.SALES_NO = KEYS.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = KEYS.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE AND (KEYS.SALES_SEQ IS NULL OR SD.SALES_SEQ = KEYS.SALES_SEQ) INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE

SELECT DISTINCT ON (FM.FTA_CODE) FM.FTA_CODE , FM.HS_CODE , FTA.FTA_NAME , FM.AMOUNT , FTA.INKOTERMS_TYPE , FM.RULE_CONTENTS , FM.COMPANY_COO_YN , FR.RVC_COMPANY_RESULT_RATE AS RVC_RATE , FR.CTC_COMPANY_RESULT_RATE AS DE_MINIMIS_RATE FROM FCR_MST FM INNER JOIN FTA_MASTER FTA ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FTA.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FTA.FTA_CODE INNER JOIN FCR_RESULT FR ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FR.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = FR.DIVISION_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FM.SALES_NO = FR.SALES_NO AND FM.SALES_SEQ = FR.SALES_SEQ AND FM.RULE_CONTENTS = FR.RULE_CODE WHERE FM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FM.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FM.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq} ORDER BY FM.FTA_CODE, FR.RULE_SEQ DESC

SELECT FR.FTA_CODE , FR.RULE_CODE , NULL AS DE_MINIMIS_AMOUNT , FR.COMPANY_COO_YN , FM.AMOUNT , FM.OUTAREA_AMOUNT , FR.RVC_COMPANY_RESULT_RATE AS RVC_RATE , FRU.RULE_DESCRIPTION AS RULE_DESCRIPTION FROM FCR_RESULT FR LEFT JOIN FTA_RULE FRU ON FRU.HS_CODE = SUBSTR(FR.HS_CODE, 1, LENGTH(FRU.HS_CODE)) AND FRU.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FRU.RULE_ID = FR.RULE_SEQ INNER JOIN FCR_MST FM ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FR.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = FR.DIVISION_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FM.SALES_NO = FR.SALES_NO AND FM.SALES_SEQ = FR.SALES_SEQ WHERE FR.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FR.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FR.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq}

SELECT FR.FTA_CODE , FTA.FTA_NAME , FR.ERROR_CODE , COALESCE(NULLIF(GET_CODE_NAME(FR.ERROR_CODE, 'ODER', FR.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR'), ''), FR.ERROR_MSG) AS ERROR_MSG FROM FCR_RESULT FR INNER JOIN FTA_MASTER FTA ON FR.COMPANY_CODE = FTA.COMPANY_CODE AND FR.FTA_CODE = FTA.FTA_CODE WHERE FR.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FR.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FR.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq} AND FR.STATUS = 'E' GROUP BY FR.COMPANY_CODE, FR.FTA_CODE, FTA.FTA_NAME, FR.ERROR_CODE, FR.ERROR_MSG ORDER BY FR.FTA_CODE

SELECT FR.FTA_CODE , FR.RULE_SEQ , FR.RULE_CODE , FR.STATUS , FR.ERROR_CODE , FR.ERROR_MSG , FRU.RULE_DESCRIPTION FROM FCR_RESULT FR LEFT JOIN FTA_RULE FRU ON FRU.HS_CODE = SUBSTR(FR.HS_CODE, 1, LENGTH(FRU.HS_CODE)) AND FRU.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FRU.RULE_ID = FR.RULE_SEQ WHERE FR.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FR.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FR.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq} ORDER BY FR.FTA_CODE, FR.RULE_SEQ

WITH BASE AS ( SELECT SM.SALES_NO , SD.SALES_SEQ , SD.DIVISION_CODE , SM.COMPANY_CODE , SM.CUSTOMER_CODE , SD.PRODUCT_CODE , SUBSTR(SM.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6) AS INVOICE_MONTH , SM.VIRTUAL_YN , SD.STATUS FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND SM.EXPORT_FLAG = 'D' AND SD.QUANTITY > 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CUSTOMER C WHERE C.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND C.CUSTOMER_CODE = SD.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE ) AND (SUBSTR(SM.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6), SD.DIVISION_CODE, SM.CUSTOMER_CODE, SD.PRODUCT_CODE) IN
(#{g.invoice_month}, #{g.division_code}, #{g.customer_code}, #{g.product_code})
((NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL))
), AGG AS ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE , INVOICE_MONTH , DIVISION_CODE , CUSTOMER_CODE , PRODUCT_CODE , SALES_NO , SALES_SEQ , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN VIRTUAL_YN = 'Y' THEN STATUS::INTEGER ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COMPANY_CODE, INVOICE_MONTH, DIVISION_CODE, CUSTOMER_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE), 0)::VARCHAR AS STATUS , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COMPANY_CODE, INVOICE_MONTH, DIVISION_CODE, CUSTOMER_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE ORDER BY VIRTUAL_YN DESC, SALES_NO, SALES_SEQ) AS RN FROM BASE ) SELECT AGG.PRODUCT_CODE , AGG.CUSTOMER_CODE , AGG.DIVISION_CODE , AGG.INVOICE_MONTH , AGG.SALES_NO , AGG.SALES_SEQ , AGG.STATUS , GET_CODE_NAME(AGG.STATUS, 'DS', #{company_code}, 'KOR') AS STATUS_NAME FROM AGG WHERE AGG.RN = 1
